author: Upsoar
body:
Post here if you wish to find another clan willing to scrim.
Look through this forum and reply to someone's post if you are interested in scrimmaging them.

Format

Clan Name : Your Clan's Name.

Available Scrim Dates And Times : A range of dates times that your clan would be available for a scrim. Specify which time zone.

(Optional) : Skype : To make getting in touch with each other easier
